title: Choose Uai's documentation composition
question: Select the structure that should carry Uai's documentation and registry. You can also combine details or request a revision.

options.label: Documentation workbench
options.lineage: shadcn documentation plus a live AI task surface
options.thesis: The documentation page itself behaves like a focused product workbench.
options.viewport: A narrow documentation rail opens into one dominant live component demonstration and its install command.
options.risk: The deep sidebar makes the homepage feel closer to a reference page than a welcoming registry entrance.

options.label: Registry browser
options.lineage: component catalog plus continuous state documentation
options.thesis: Discovery, preview, installation, and accessibility share one dense workspace.
options.case: Strongest for developers who arrive knowing which component they need.
options.viewport: A searchable component index sits beside a large selected-component preview with several useful states.
options.risk: The catalog-first opening communicates utility before it communicates Uai's point of view.

options.label: Specimen wall
options.lineage: Beautiful UI specimens plus shadcn open-code principles
options.thesis: A cobalt state rail turns the opening into one living component system rather than a marketing collage.
options.case: Best balance of product identity, live examples, and a clear path into the registry.
options.viewport: A restrained introduction occupies one third while four connected AI-native patterns dominate the remaining canvas.
options.risk: The signature rail must remain functional in documentation pages or it becomes decorative branding.
